boundaries: 本报告仅为冻结提交的派生研究快照，不写回 Canonical，也不是持续维护接口。
既有种子类别为 draft / editorial_navigation_only，可重叠，不是正式领域分类或全库分类。
原始 domains 标签逐字保留；不合并同义词、不将标签映射到种子类别。
未记录不等于不存在；无领域标签、无种子成员关系或无图边都不能证明现实领域为空。
Candidate、accepted Candidate 和直接 Canonical 引用保留不同来源；Canonical 数按稳定 ID 去重。
原始 type/kind 与既有规范化描述同时保留；legacy reference_project 不被自动升级成某种成熟先例身份。
互通、对齐、协同是并列非互斥的问题维度，不在此强制分箱或设置阶段。
225 条显式关系与能力字段引用分别列出；候选关系提案不进入 Canonical 图。
无全球或领域总体分母，不计算方案空间覆盖百分比；不重验外部标准的新鲜度。

context.conditions_zh: 依据固定公开源码及 RFC 9043 对 FFmpeg 参考实现的标识，仅记录原生 libavcodec FFV1 软件编码器/解码器对版本 0、1、3 的受支持配置实现；不是全部 RFC 特性或通用符合性认证。v3 编码设置 micro-version 4。版本 0/1 为单 slice；多 slice 或 two-pass 要求更高版本，在本范围内须使用 v3，two-pass 不能配 Golomb-Rice。较高位深受像素格式和版本约束，编码器对本范围内大于 8-bit 的路径使用 range coder，不能把注册格式列表理解为每个格式适用于每个版本。Bayer、浮点/remapping 和 ec=2 CRC 路径需要被排除的 v4；普通 ec=1 CRC 要求 v3。实验性版本 2/4、Vulkan 和其他硬件路径均不属于本边。原生编解码组件有独立构建开关，且选择内部 rangecoder；不保证任意发行二进制包含这些组件，也不意味着整个 FFmpeg 无外部依赖。许可取决于构建配置及外部库。仅检视源码及上游 v0/v3 测试配方，未构建或执行 FFmpeg/FATE，未在所检配方块发现显式 v1 测试，v1 证据来自编码/解析源码。RFC附录中的历史测试或安全陈述不迁移到 9.0.2；不声称第三方互通、部署安全、IA采用、任意输入有效性或所有转换的像素/色彩/元数据/容器无损。保持既有 RFC 对象的信息类状态及身份不变。
context.conditions_en: Fixed public source plus RFC 9043 identification of the FFmpeg reference implementation support only native libavcodec FFV1 software encoding/decoding of supported versions 0/1/3 configurations, not every RFC feature or universal conformance. Version 3 encoding sets micro-version 4. Versions 0/1 use one slice; multislice or two-pass needs a later version, v3 within this scope, and two-pass cannot use Golomb-Rice. Higher depths have pixel-format/version constraints; above 8-bit encoding within this scope uses range coding. The registration list does not mean every format works with every version. Bayer, float/remapping and ec=2 CRC paths require excluded v4; ordinary ec=1 CRC requires v3. Experimental versions 2/4, Vulkan and other hardware paths are excluded. Separate native codec build gates select the internal range coder; arbitrary binaries need not include the components, and the distribution is not declared dependency-free. Licensing depends on build options and external libraries. Source and upstream v0/v3 recipes were inspected, not built or executed; no explicit v1 test appears in the inspected recipe block, so v1 support is source-backed. Historical RFC appendix testing/security statements are not transferred to 9.0.2. No third-party interoperability, deployment security, IA adoption, arbitrary-input validity or lossless preservation across all pixel/color/metadata/container conversions is asserted. The existing RFC object retains its Informational status and identity.

context.conditions_zh: 依据固定 libavformat/hls.c 对 RFC 8216 的明示引用和实际读取路径，仅记录 EXTM3U、EXTINF、TARGETDURATION、MEDIA-SEQUENCE、PLAYLIST-TYPE EVENT/VOD、ENDLIST、BYTERANGE 及有限 STREAM-INF/MEDIA 处理、片段 URI 解析和受支持的未加密 MPEG-TS 片段经可用子解复用器打开的路径。不是全部标签、属性或输入的严格验证：EXT-X-VERSION 没有解析分支而被通用注释路径跳过，不声称完整第 7 版客户端或 RFC §7 版本兼容性验证。I-FRAME、SESSION、DATERANGE 及显式 DISCONTINUITY 标签也未在该解析器设分支；这不证明所有下游不连续性机制均不存在。动态变体/质量切换不受支持，CLOSED-CAPTIONS 不由该 rendition 路径支持。调用方流选择、协议/扩展名约束、IO、编译组件、HTTP/HTTPS/TLS 后端与子解复用器可用性适用；扩展名被允许不保证编解码兼容性。排除加密/DRM、复用和片段生成、fMP4/CMAF、packed-audio/WebVTT 细节及当前 Apple/LL-HLS 扩展；不把部分 KEY 代码当作通用解密支持。仅检视公开固定源码和测试配方，未安装、构建或运行 FFmpeg/FATE，未连接网络流；不声称完整客户端/服务器符合性、安全认证、网络或第三方互通、任意构建可用性或 IA 采用。
context.conditions_en: Based on the explicit RFC 8216 reference and operative fixed libavformat/hls.c read paths, limited to EXTM3U, EXTINF, TARGETDURATION, MEDIA-SEQUENCE, PLAYLIST-TYPE EVENT/VOD, ENDLIST, BYTERANGE, bounded STREAM-INF/MEDIA handling, segment URI resolution and opening supported unencrypted MPEG-TS segments through an available subdemuxer. This is not strict validation of every tag, attribute or input: EXT-X-VERSION has no parser branch and is skipped by generic comment handling, so no complete version-7 client or RFC §7 version-compatibility validation is claimed. I-FRAME, SESSION, DATERANGE and explicit DISCONTINUITY tags also lack branches in that parser; this does not prove all downstream discontinuity mechanisms absent. Dynamic variant/quality switching is unsupported; CLOSED-CAPTIONS is unsupported by that rendition path. Caller stream selection, protocol/extension constraints, IO, enabled components, HTTP/HTTPS/TLS backends and subdemuxer availability apply; an allowed extension does not guarantee codec compatibility. Encryption/DRM, muxing and segment production, fMP4/CMAF, packed-audio/WebVTT specifics and current Apple/LL-HLS extensions are excluded; partial KEY machinery is not general decryption support. Public fixed source and test recipes were inspected only: no FFmpeg/FATE installation, build, execution or network-stream exercise. No complete client/server conformance, security certification, network/third-party interoperability, arbitrary-build availability or IA adoption is established.

context.conditions_zh: 固定9.0.2原生libavcodec dpx软件解码路径，与ST 268-1:2014所述DPX 2.0头布局和样本打包的有界静态对应，不是上游对2014全文符合性的声明。只限格式有效、未加密、大端SDPX/V2.0、orientation=0、一个unsigned RGB元素(descriptor=50)、10-bit、packing=1(method A)、encoding=0；全局与首元素数据偏移一致且至少2048，行紧排为4×width字节且无额外行/图像padding，电影/电视帧率和电视timecode为未定义值。调用方提供完整文件AVPacket，尺寸及缓冲区通过库约束，组件已启用并选择软件AV_PIX_FMT_GBRP10路径。代码从32位字依次取RGB，写入GBR平面；不承诺颜色解释/变换或其他元数据保真。仅检视固定源码，未编译、运行或测试FFmpeg/FATE、媒体和第三方互通。不是完整/核心符合性验证器：多元素、其他方向/符号/位深/packing、RLE、加密、额外padding、色度/ADX、时间码、Vulkan、序列输入或写入均不纳入。编码器写V1.0，不能沿此证据声称DPX 2.0写入。
context.conditions_en: Bounded static correspondence of the fixed 9.0.2 native libavcodec dpx software decoder to ST 268-1:2014 DPX 2.0 header/sample layout, not an upstream declaration of full 2014 conformance. Only well-formed, unencrypted, big-endian SDPX/V2.0, orientation 0, one unsigned RGB element (descriptor 50), 10-bit, packing 1 (method A), encoding 0; equal global/first-element data offsets at least 2048, tightly packed rows of 4*width bytes with no additional line/image padding, and undefined film/TV frame-rate and TV timecode fields. Caller supplies a complete-file AVPacket, dimensions/buffers meet library constraints, the decoder is enabled and software AV_PIX_FMT_GBRP10 is selected. Code extracts RGB from each 32-bit word into GBR planes; color interpretation/transformation and other metadata preservation are not claimed. Fixed-source inspection only: no FFmpeg/FATE build, media execution or third-party interoperation. Not a full/core-conformance validator. Multiple elements, other orientations/signs/depths/packing, RLE, encryption, extra padding, colorimetry/ADX, timecode, Vulkan, sequence input and writing are excluded. The encoder emits V1.0, not evidence for DPX 2.0 writing.

context.conditions_zh: 实现固定 Git 2.52.0 与其同提交 ls-refs 文档；既有 #497 使用 Git 2.51.0 文档，两份文档的完整 ls-refs 段逐字节相同，但全文不同。这个有限对应不等于完整版次相同，不把工作级 git_protocol_v2 标准改成 Git 软件版次。 仅据固定源码，研究已选择传输协议 v2 的 upload-pack 服务端 ls-refs 路径：serve 调度命令，读取 peel、symrefs、ref-prefix、unborn 参数，经仓库 namespace、hideRefs 与配置条件筛选引用，格式化对象标识符/引用名及条件性符号引用目标、peeled 对象或 unborn HEAD，再写 stdout pkt-line 并 flush。stdout 写入与刷新不证明网络传输、对端收到或可靠交付。ref-prefix 是优化而非严格授权过滤；达到 65,536 条及以上时清空前缀优化，规范允许服务端返回不匹配引用、由客户端再筛。lsrefs.unborn 的 advertise（默认）、allow 与 ignore 分别控制公告/接受；隐藏引用处理不证明安全隔离。仓库、配置、资源与输出错误仍适用，不保证任意输入或仓库均成功；不是完整仓库清单。只检视源码和测试配方，未安装、构建或执行下载的 Git、协议测试或网络服务；环境中用于 IA 记账的 Git 不算本源码执行。排除 fetch/packfile/clone/push、完整协商、完整 Git/v2 符合性、仓库原子一致性、认证/TLS/SSH/安全、跨实现互通、性能、当前平台兼容性及 IA/GitHub 部署版次或采用证明；未研究功能不表示软件缺失。
context.conditions_en: Implementation and matching ls-refs documentation are fixed to Git 2.52.0. Existing PR497 evidence uses Git 2.51.0 documentation: the complete ls-refs subsections are byte-identical, but the full documents differ. This finite correspondence is not whole-edition equality and does not relabel the work-level git_protocol_v2 standard as a Git software release. From fixed source only, this reviews the server ls-refs path after upload-pack has selected wire protocol v2: serve dispatches the command, reads peel, symrefs, ref-prefix and unborn arguments, filters references under repository namespace, hideRefs and configuration conditions, formats object IDs/refnames and conditional symref targets, peeled objects or unborn HEAD, then writes stdout pkt-lines and flushes. Writing/flushing stdout is not evidence of network transfer, peer receipt or reliable delivery. ref-prefix is an optimization, not strict authorization filtering; at 65,536 or more prefix lines the optimization is cleared, and the specification permits nonmatching references for clients to filter. lsrefs.unborn advertise (default), allow and ignore distinguish advertisement/acceptance behavior; hidden-reference processing does not establish security isolation. Repository, configuration, resource and output errors apply, with no every-input/repository success or complete-reference-inventory guarantee. Source and test recipes were inspected only: no downloaded Git installation, build, execution, protocol test or network service. Environment Git used for IA bookkeeping is not execution evidence for this source. Fetch/packfile/clone/push, complete negotiation, complete Git/v2 conformance, repository atomic consistency, authentication/TLS/SSH/security, cross-implementation interoperability, performance, current-platform compatibility and IA/GitHub deployed-version or adoption claims are excluded; unreviewed functions are not asserted absent.

context.conditions_zh: 只限固定 RFC 8216（2017-08）§4.3.2.7.1 的可选 Media Playlist 表示，目标按 §11.1 限定 ANSI/SCTE 35（2014-08）。源媒体中的 SCTE-35 拼接信息 MAY 由 EXT-X-DATERANGE 表示，不是所有 HLS 播放列表必需支持的特性。本批只审阅该节第二段的具体情况：包含 splice_null()、splice_schedule()、bandwidth_reservation() 或 private_cmd() 的 splice_info_section() SHOULD 通过 SCTE35-CMD 属性表示，值为整个 section 的大端二进制十六进制序列；不把 SHOULD 提升为 MUST。§4.3.2.7 中 ID 与 START-DATE 必需，含 DateRange 的播放列表 MUST 有至少一个 EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME。该节映射还规定 SCTE35-CMD 的 START-DATE MUST 对应命令的 splice_time()，无该时间时对应命令出现在源流中的节目时间。此处不是穷尽 DateRange 语法或所有 SCTE35 命令映射的实现配方；未声称对 splice_insert()/time_signal()/segmentation_descriptor() 的其他映射、§8.10 示例或后来 HLS 扩展完成审阅/测试。仅为有版次/属性/命令条件的 uses，不是全 HLS 强制依赖、完整 SCTE35 语法符合性、软件/设备支持、广告交付、无缝拼接、互通、安全性、部署或 IA 采用。
context.conditions_en: Limited to the optional Media Playlist representation in fixed RFC8216 (2017-08) section4.3.2.7.1, with the ANSI/SCTE35 (2014-08) target pinned by section11.1. Source-media SCTE35 splice information MAY use EXT-X-DATERANGE; it is not required in every HLS playlist. The reviewed operative case is the second paragraph: a splice_info_section() containing splice_null(), splice_schedule(), bandwidth_reservation() or private_cmd() SHOULD be represented in SCTE35-CMD as a hexadecimal sequence of the whole section in big-endian binary. SHOULD is not promoted to MUST. Section4.3.2.7 requires ID and START-DATE, and a playlist with DateRange MUST contain at least one EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME. The mapping further requires SCTE35-CMD START-DATE to be the command splice_time(), or the program time at which the command appeared in the source stream if it specifies no splice_time(). This is not an exhaustive DateRange grammar or implementation recipe for all SCTE35 commands. Other splice_insert()/time_signal()/segmentation_descriptor() mappings, section8.10 examples and later HLS extensions are not claimed reviewed/tested. This version-, attribute- and command-conditioned uses relation does not establish mandatory whole-HLS dependency, full SCTE35 syntax conformance, software/device support, ad delivery, seamless splicing, interoperability, security, deployment or IA adoption.

context.conditions_zh: 仅限实际 YAML 1.2 文档上下文中的文本解析/输出，以及支持的 JavaScript 可表示映射、序列与标量子集。修订 1.2.2 定义同一 1.2 语言且无规范性变更；不能仅凭版本文字推断符合性。version:'1.2' 是默认值，不覆盖指令或继承的 1.1 流状态。默认 Number 精度、Object 字符串键碰撞、Map 身份/别名碰撞、仅部分标量 === 比较的 uniqueKeys（包括遗漏 NaN 重复键） 和带错误的部分值（即使 Document.toString 拒绝输出）限制该关系。所查重复输入在 parse 的 logLevel:'silent' 下以后值为准，调用者须检查错误/警告。intAsBigInt 仅处理整数；schema:'json' 是 YAML 的 JSON 兼容 schema，不是 JSON Schema 验证。别名循环、默认 Core 的显式 YAML 1.1 已知标签、自定义回调及可选 merge 不保证核心 JSON 或普遍互通。Document/parse-stringify 输出不保证词法无损或通用跨语言往返。固定源码与 47 项有限诊断加单独 3 项键补充不证明完整 1.2.2 符合性、全部 API/浏览器一致性、安全、资源上界、规范化/签名输出或 IA 采用。
context.conditions_en: Only YAML text parsing/emission in actual YAML 1.2 document contexts, with the supported JavaScript-representable subset of mappings, sequences and scalar values. Revision 1.2.2 defines the same 1.2 language without normative changes; version spelling alone is not conformance evidence. version:'1.2' is a default, not an override of directives or inherited 1.1 stream state. Default Number precision, Object string-key collisions, Map identity/alias collisions, partial scalar === uniqueKeys comparison (including missed NaN duplicates), and error-bearing partial values despite Document.toString refusal bound this edge. The checked duplicate parse with logLevel:'silent' returns last-wins data; callers inspect errors/warnings. intAsBigInt addresses integers only; schema:'json' is YAML's JSON-compatible schema, not JSON Schema validation. Alias cycles, explicit known YAML 1.1 tags under default Core, custom callbacks and optional merge are not core JSON or universal interoperability guarantees. Document/parse-stringify output is not lexical losslessness or universal cross-language roundtrip. Fixed-source claims and 47 finite diagnostics plus a separate three-key supplement do not establish full 1.2.2 conformance, all-API/browser parity, safety, resource bounds, canonical/signature output or IA adoption.

context.conditions_zh: 本记录固定 libcbor 0.12.0、官方 tag v0.12.0 与 commit ae000f44e8d2a69e1f72a738f7c0b6b4b7cc4fbf，仅静态核验 cbor_stream_decode 对 RFC8949 §§3/3.1 的有限 token 解码：major type 0 无符号整数的内嵌值及 1/2/4/8 字节大端参数，以及 major type 2/3 的 definite 字节串/文本，后者只限长度 0..255 且长度头为内嵌长度或一个参数字节，不含 2/4/8 字节长度参数分支。调用方须提供真实可读缓冲及正确 source_size、有效回调函数指针，并在回调使用期间保持输入有效；可复制 cbor_empty_callbacks 的有效 no-op 函数后替换所需回调，不能把空指针视为 no-op。文本正面映射以调用方先保证 payload 为有效 UTF-8 为前提，低层函数本身不验证 UTF-8。每次调用从当前 token 起点独立解析；FINISHED 只表示恰一次回调，不表示整个缓冲或完整 CBOR 文档已解码/验证。整数回调按 wire width 选择 uint8/16/32/64，内嵌值用 uint8；对应 read 总长为 1/2/3/5/9，required=0。非首选整数编码也可接收，例如 0x18 0x00，并无最短表示或确定性编码验证。短 definite 字串头长 h 为1或2，payload 长 n，完整时回调借用 source+h 指针和字节长度 n，read=h+n、required=0；不复制 payload、不转移所有权、不补 NUL，也不延长输入生命周期。零长可回调头后指针与长度0，不允许据此越界解引用。截断时 NEDATA、read=0、无回调；required 是从原 token 起点算的所需总缓冲长度，不是额外字节数。无输入时 required=1；只有0x58/0x78头时 required=2，得到长度n但 payload 不足时 required=2+n。该低层函数不保留流解析状态；调用方须保留不完整前缀，补齐后重新调用，并在成功后自行按 read 推进。固定 data.h 无输入时 read=1 的注释与源码/测试配方不符，实际为 read=0、required=1；callbacks.h 部分 definite/indefinite 注释倒置，按实际 dispatch 限定。上游字符串测试有仅分配头却虚报 source_size 的配方，回调只比较指针和长度，不是有效 payload、UTF-8 或内存安全证据；0x61 0xFF 配方也不是有效文本证据。截断 helper 虽循环 available，却始终 decode(data,1)，不能称全前缀测试覆盖。完整固定源码/测试配方仅阅读，未安装、导入、构建、运行上游或其测试，未向解码器提供输入。此边不是完整 RFC 符合性或上游完整符合自述的认证；不核嵌套、映射/重复键、文档终止/尾随数据、负数、标签、浮点、不定长容器、编码器、高层 API、大长度/size_t 溢出路径、JSON转换、跨实现互通、安全/资源/性能或 IA 采用。函数体自身无分配不代表用户回调或整个应用零分配/安全。未纳入范围不表示库没有其他能力。
context.conditions_en: This record pins libcbor 0.12.0, official tag v0.12.0 and commit ae000f44e8d2a69e1f72a738f7c0b6b4b7cc4fbf, and statically inspects only a limited cbor_stream_decode token-decoding slice of RFC8949 sections 3/3.1: major type 0 unsigned integers with embedded values or 1/2/4/8-byte big-endian arguments, and major type 2/3 definite byte/text strings restricted to lengths 0..255 with an embedded length or a one-byte length argument, excluding 2/4/8-byte length-argument branches. Callers must provide a genuinely readable buffer and correct source_size, valid callback function pointers, and input lifetime covering callback use. They may copy the valid no-op functions in cbor_empty_callbacks and replace selected callbacks; null pointers are not no-ops. Positive text mapping requires the caller to ensure valid UTF-8 payload beforehand; this low-level function does not validate UTF-8. Each fresh call parses from the current token start. FINISHED means exactly one callback, not complete decoding or validation of the buffer or a CBOR document. Integer callbacks select uint8/16/32/64 by wire width, with uint8 for embedded values; total read is 1/2/3/5/9 and required=0. Nonpreferred integer encodings such as 0x18 0x00 are also accepted, without shortest-form or deterministic-encoding validation. For short definite strings, header size h is 1 or 2 and payload size is n; completion passes a borrowed source+h pointer and byte length n, with read=h+n and required=0. It neither copies payload, transfers ownership, adds NUL nor extends input lifetime. A zero-length callback can pass a pointer after the header with length 0, which grants no permission to dereference beyond the buffer. Truncation yields NEDATA, read=0 and no callback; required is the total buffer length needed from the original token start, not an additional-byte count. No input requires 1 byte; a lone 0x58/0x78 requires 2; once n is known, incomplete payload requires 2+n. No stream parser state is retained internally by this low-level function: callers preserve incomplete prefixes, append data and retry, and advance by read after success. The fixed data.h comment saying no-input read=1 disagrees with code/test recipes: actual read=0 and required=1. Several callbacks.h definite/indefinite comments are reversed, so actual dispatch controls this scope. Some upstream string recipes allocate only headers but overstate source_size, and callbacks compare pointers/lengths only; they are not evidence of valid payload, UTF-8 or memory safety. The 0x61 0xFF recipe is not valid-text evidence either. The truncation helper loops over available but always calls decode(data,1), so it does not prove all-prefix coverage. Complete fixed source and test recipes were read only, with no upstream installation, import, build, execution or tests and no decoder inputs. This edge does not certify full RFC conformance or upstream full-conformance claims. Nesting, maps/duplicate keys, document termination/trailing data, negatives, tags, floats, indefinite containers, encoding, high-level APIs, large-length/size_t overflow paths, JSON conversion, cross-implementation interchange, security/resources/performance and IA adoption are unverified. No allocations in the function body does not imply allocation-free or safe callbacks/applications. Unexamined capabilities are not asserted absent.

context.conditions_zh: 固定 libltc 1.3.2、官方轻量 tag v1.3.2 与 commit bf84b01097a1789c0296cc5fcfc3bf4608407930。只据固定源码将 ltc_frame_increment 的有界时间地址算术映射到 SMPTE ST 12-1:2014 §6.2 的 25 帧计数及 §8.2 的十位/个位 BCD 表示，不以旧 SMPTE 12M-1999 注释证明版次等同或完整符合性。调用方提供生命周期有效、可读写且无并发修改的 LTCFrame 对象，以命名字段访问；每一十进制位均合法（个位 0..9），组合值为帧 00..24、秒/分 00..59、时 00..23。仅组合数值落在范围内而个别 BCD 位非法并不满足前提。fps 必须为 25，dfbit 为 0，standard 为 LTC_TV_625_50，flags 恰为 LTC_NO_PARITY（枚举值 8），不启用 LTC_USE_DATE（1）。以枚举和实现为准，不采用头文件注释中误称 bit 4 的描述。每次调用仅将八个时间地址字段推进一个计数位置：帧 24 后进秒，秒/分 59 后进位，23:59:59:24 回到 00:00:00:00；仅该全天回绕返回 1，其余合法输入返回 0。此为静态控制流推导，不是运行结果；该范围内日期错误返回 -1 的路径不可达。函数不初始化对象，也不验证空指针、BCD 合法性或帧率；非法输入不在正面范围。standard 参数在该不计算奇偶校正的分支不起作用，但不能据此泛化其他调用。用户字段、标志、奇偶校正字段和 sync_word 的逻辑值不变，不声称结构体字节/填充逐字节保真。LTC_NO_PARITY 有意跳过奇偶校正，旧值可能不再适合改变后的地址，故结果不是已经符合完整 LTC 码字要求的证明。本切片不校验 C 位域的内存布局、大小端或线上位序，不执行编码、解码、音频波形、同步或传输；也不覆盖丢帧计数、其他帧率、50 帧帧对、PAL 色帧、日期/时区、用户位语义、时间精度或完整标准符合性。函数名称含 LTC 不把时间地址算术自动变成 LTC 信号验证。七份选定完整固定仓库文件仅静态读取，没有安装、导入、构建、运行上游或其测试。tests/ltcloop.c 是单帧编解码回环配方，不是本 BCD 进位切片的执行或全范围测试证据。固定库源/头文件声明 LGPL-3.0-or-later，仅记录上游许可声明，不作法律适用性判断。发布归档未核，未证明跨库/设备互通、安全、性能、部署或 IA 采用；未审能力不等于库不具备。
context.conditions_en: Pins libltc 1.3.2, official lightweight tag v1.3.2 and commit bf84b01097a1789c0296cc5fcfc3bf4608407930. Fixed source alone maps bounded ltc_frame_increment time-address arithmetic to the 25-frame progression in SMPTE ST 12-1:2014 section 6.2 and tens/units BCD representation in section 8.2; old SMPTE 12M-1999 comments do not establish edition equivalence or full conformance. The caller supplies a live readable/writable LTCFrame object without concurrent modification and accesses named fields. Every decimal digit is valid (units 0..9), with combined frames 00..24, seconds/minutes 00..59 and hours 00..23. A valid combined numeric range alone does not suffice if an individual BCD digit is invalid. fps is exactly 25, dfbit is 0, standard is LTC_TV_625_50, and flags is exactly LTC_NO_PARITY (enum value 8), excluding LTC_USE_DATE (1). The enum and implementation govern, not the header comment incorrectly saying bit 4. Each call advances only the eight time-address fields one count: frame 24 carries into seconds, seconds/minutes 59 carry, and 23:59:59:24 wraps to 00:00:00:00. Only that day wrap returns 1; all other valid inputs return 0. These are static control-flow deductions, not execution results; the date-error return -1 is unreachable within this domain. The function neither initializes the object nor validates null pointers, BCD digits or frame rate; invalid inputs are outside positive scope. The standard argument is unused on this parity-suppressed branch, not generally ignored. Logical values of user fields, flags, parity field and sync_word remain unchanged, without byte-for-byte object-representation or padding preservation claims. LTC_NO_PARITY intentionally skips parity correction; its previous value may no longer fit the changed address, so this is not proof of a complete conforming LTC codeword. This slice does not verify C bit-field layout, endianness or wire bit order, or execute encoding, decoding, audio waveforms, synchronization or transport. Drop-frame counting, other rates, 50-frame pairs, PAL color framing, dates/timezones, user-bit semantics, timing accuracy and full-standard conformance are excluded. LTC in the function name does not turn address arithmetic into LTC-signal verification. Seven selected complete pinned repository files were read statically, without upstream installation, import, build, execution or tests. tests/ltcloop.c is a one-frame encode/decode loopback recipe, not executed or comprehensive testing of this BCD-carry slice. Fixed library source/headers declare LGPL-3.0-or-later; this records upstream licensing, not legal suitability. The release archive was not verified. Cross-library/device interoperability, security, performance, deployment and IA adoption are unproved; unexamined capabilities are not asserted absent.

context.conditions_en: Only fixed WebApplicationClient authorization parameters, callback code/error parsing, token-request form construction and token-response-body parsing were verified, not complete RFC6749 conformance. Callback state comparison requires a truthy expected state; prepare_authorization_request generates/stores state, and prepare_token_request invokes callback parsing only with a truthy authorization_response. Integrations manage session/one-time transaction lifecycle, trusted endpoint/callback/issuer binding, redirect-URI consistency, confidential-client authentication and credential/token protection. client_id may be serialized by default but is not authenticated proof; optional client_secret can be serialized, while this path does not itself construct HTTP Basic or complete authenticated transport. Methods prepare strings/tuples and send no HTTP; configurable HTTPS-prefix guards do not verify certificates, HTTP responses or endpoint authenticity, and body-only helpers have no URL to check. PKCE is an optional extension defaulting to plain; S256 plus corresponding challenge/verifier must be explicitly configured/passed, not inferred from constructor attributes. Response parsing allows JSON/form fallback, checks only presence of access_token, rejects missing token_type only with the truthy strict option, and permits relaxing scope-change checks; it is not token authenticity, JWT or identity validation. RFC9700 section2.1.1 requires public-client PKCE and recommends confidential-client PKCE with transaction binding; section2.4 prohibits password grants, and library support for other grants is no deployment recommendation. No full BCP conformity, production security, third-party interoperability certification or IA adoption is asserted. Python>=3.9 is package metadata, not tested runtime compatibility; BSD3 and optional extras are not a license-compatibility audit. Fixed source and test definitions only: no library install/import/execution, distribution archive download, actual credentials or network authorization.

context.conditions_en: This record pins Pion RTCP 1.2.19, official tag v1.2.19 and commit 09df03af9612ef9ed56c073b9a8de82f2ee035d2, and covers only SenderReport/ReceiverReport base packet field Marshal/Unmarshal under RFC3550 sections 6.4.1/6.4.2 and section 4 big-endian byte order, not full RTCP conformance. Errors may leave partial state; target reuse is outside this contract. SR/RR Marshal rejects more than 31 report blocks and emits V=2, P=false and the appropriate packet type/length. The 64-bit NTPTime, 32-bit RTPTime, SSRC, counts and report statistics fields encode supplied values, not clock sampling/synchronization, NTP/RTP mapping, loss/jitter/RTT computation or actual transport. The upstream SR “valid” test recipe contains 52 bytes but length=7 declares 32 bytes; it is not used as a conformance vector. Source and test recipes were inspected only, without installing, importing, building or running upstream or its tests. No complete RTP/RTCP session, compound/SDES-CNAME rules, scheduling/member/SSRC management, other RTCP packet types, RFC5506, profile extensions, network transport, SRTP/SRTCP, security, third-party interoperability or IA adoption is claimed. context.conditions_en: Limited to the abstract graph data model in this Candidate Recommendation Snapshot: an RDF graph is a set of triples, with an IRI or blank-node subject, an IRI predicate, and an object that may also be a literal or triple term. The specification supplies a model for concrete syntaxes, APIs and query languages and explicitly states that implementations cannot conform directly to this Concepts document. Storage, query execution, software interoperability, legacy IA adoption/export plans and other RDF 1.1/1.2 mappings are not verified.

context.conditions_zh: 沿用既有条件性选择判断：当版本表达重点转向发布时间、发布周期或时间敏感性时，CalVer 可作为 SemVer 的替代路线。SemVer 2.0.0 要求声明公共 API，并以版本递增表达相应兼容性变化（0.y.z 初始开发和预发行规则仍适用）；CalVer 是多种日历方案的约定，不由日历数字本身保证 API 兼容性。此边不表示规则或版本号完全可互换，也不要求二选一；实际方案可结合日历信息与其他版本语义，但不因此自动符合 SemVer 的兼容性增号规则。不据此替任何项目选型，亦不表示 IA 采用。
context.conditions_en: Preserves the existing conditional choice: CalVer can be an alternative when version-expression goals emphasize release dates, cadence or time sensitivity. SemVer 2.0.0 requires a declared public API and version increments communicating the corresponding compatibility changes, subject to its initial-development and prerelease rules; CalVer is a convention covering multiple calendar schemes, whose date numbers do not themselves guarantee API compatibility. This does not make the rules or version identifiers interchangeable or require an exclusive choice; a scheme may combine calendar information with other version semantics without thereby satisfying SemVer compatibility-increment rules. No project-specific choice or IA adoption is asserted.

context.conditions_zh: 本页 SenML RFC 8428 → JSON RFC 8259 的“使用”仅指原版 application/senml+json 与 application/sensml+json 两种表示的文献级编码使用，不表示其他 SenML 表示均使用 JSON 编码或每个实现均须支持 JSON。流式 SenSML 与非流 SenML 需分别协商；流接收不能等待可能永不到达的包结束标记。任意 JSON 不一定是有效 SenML；尚未终止的 SenSML 流不保证每个时刻都是完整 JSON 文本。本关系不声称 JSON 文本序列格式或实现符合性，也不证明完整验证、无损转换或 IA 采用。仅限原始出版物，RFC 9100 更新及勘误未整合。
context.conditions_en: The SenML RFC 8428 → JSON RFC 8259 uses link is limited to documentary encoding use by the original application/senml+json and application/sensml+json representations. It does not require JSON encoding for every SenML representation or JSON support in every implementation. Streaming SenSML and non-streaming SenML require separate negotiation; a stream receiver cannot wait for a possibly absent end-of-pack marker. Arbitrary JSON is not necessarily valid SenML, and an unfinished SenSML stream need not be a complete JSON text at every instant. This relation does not assert the JSON Text Sequences format, implementation conformance, complete validation, lossless conversion or IA adoption. Only original publications are covered; RFC 9100 updates and errata are not consolidated.

context.conditions_zh: 固定 ST 377-1:2019 → ST 336:2017；§3 页 9 明确该版本引用，§§6.3–6.3.9 页 30/32/33 给出实际编码要求，不只是书目关联。MXF 数据项、集合与包采用 ST 336 KLV，除可选 Run-In 外数据连续编码、无间隙。MXF KLV Keys 和 ULs 必须 16 字节；这不把组内 Local Tags 误称为完整键。MXF 编码器可选 BER 短式或长式长度，长式总编码长度不得超过 9 字节，数值小于 128 也可用长式；0x80 未定长度禁止。解码器须处理短/长式且不得假定长度字段固定字节数。Local Sets 至少须解码 2 字节 Tag 配 2 字节长度或 BER 长度的语法；Variable-Length Packs 至少须解码 2 字节长度或 BER 长度的语法；这两类的全部 ST 336 形式仅为 SHOULD，不升级为全部强制。Defined-Length Packs 按 ST 336 解码，不等同固定常数总长度；上述三类编码器使用符合 ST 336 的 Keys。其他 MXF 规范可加长度约束。递归分组一般不允许，除非相关 Application-Specific Metadata、Descriptive Metadata 或 Essence Container 规范另定；MXF Structural 和 MXF Descriptive Metadata Sets 仍禁止递归组结构。官方 MXF 页 8 Scope 的 /StrikeOut 批注权威/含义未知，未用被划线文字作干净规范依据；这里的固定引用和操作页没有批注。仅表示这些标准条款之间受约束的 uses，不是两格式等同、任意 KLV 接受、所有解码器实际能力、完整符合性、codec/profile/素材容器支持、第三方互通、安全认证或 IA 采用。
context.conditions_en: Fixed ST 377-1:2019 → ST 336:2017: the dated normative reference is on page 9 and operative §§6.3–6.3.9 are on pages 30/32/33, not merely a bibliography association. MXF data items, sets and packs use ST 336 KLV, with contiguous coding and no gaps except optional Run-In. MXF KLV Keys and ULs must be 16 bytes; group-local tags are not misidentified as full keys. Encoders may use BER short or long length forms, with long-form encoding limited to nine bytes total, even for values below 128; 0x80 unspecified length is forbidden. Decoders must handle both forms without assuming fixed length-field size. Required Local Set syntax support covers two-byte tags with two-byte or BER lengths; required Variable-Length Pack support covers two-byte or BER lengths. Support for all ST 336 forms of these two constructs is only SHOULD, not universally mandatory. Defined-Length Packs are decoded as specified by ST 336, not assumed to have constant total length; encoders use ST 336-compliant keys for all three constructs. Other MXF specifications may add length constraints. Recursive grouping is generally prohibited unless specified by an Application-Specific Metadata, Descriptive Metadata or Essence Container specification; recursive structures remain prohibited in MXF Structural and MXF Descriptive Metadata Sets. The official MXF page 8 Scope StrikeOut annotation has unknown authority/meaning and its struck-through text is not used as clean normative evidence; the cited reference and operative pages have no annotations. This bounded standards-level uses assertion does not establish format equivalence, arbitrary KLV acceptance, actual decoder capabilities, full conformance, codec/profile/essence-container support, third-party interoperability, security certification or IA adoption.

context.conditions_zh: 固定源端 ST 377-1:2019、目标端 ST 330:2011，均保持既有工作级身份；MXF §3 第 8 页明确该日期版本，而不是以 2022 修订代替。§4.2 第 18 页要求 UMID 用作 Package ID 时仅使用 32 字节 Basic UMID。规范性 Annex B.1 第 118 页将 Generic Package 定义为抽象类，其 Package UID 是必需的 32 字节 PackageID，表示不可变的包标识 UMID。Annex B.10 第 123 页在 Source Clip 存在时要求其 32 字节 SourcePackageID（PackageRef）标识所引用包；终止 source-reference chain 时明确使用 32 个零字节。这是上下文中的终止哨兵，不是普通生成的唯一 UMID，也不表示每个 MXF 文件必有 Source Clip。64 字节 Extended UMID 不允许用于这里的 Package ID；第 18 页关于其他 MXF 规范可能使用 Extended 的注释不放宽此规则。原始官方 MXF 第 8 页 Scope 的 StrikeOut 批注权威/含义未知；未删除批注或将划线 Scope 当作干净规范依据。下方 ST 330:2011 引用不受批注覆盖，第 18/118/123 页无批注；不声称第 8 页整体无批注。本关系只表示这些规范性包身份条款的 uses，保持既有 MXF/KLV 对象、描述和完整记录验证时间不变；不是两标准等同、一般兼容性、生成器唯一性/真实性、版权/权利/可信来源保证、完整文件或软件符合性、跨实现互通、安全认证或 IA 采用。
context.conditions_en: Fixed source ST 377-1:2019 and target ST 330:2011 retain their work-level identities. MXF section 3 on page 8 names that exact edition, not the later 2022 revision. Section 4.2 on page 18 requires only the 32-byte Basic UMID when UMID is used as Package ID. Normative Annex B.1 on page 118 defines Generic Package as an abstract class with a required 32-byte Package UID of type PackageID, representing the immutable package identifier as a UMID. Annex B.10 on page 123 requires a 32-byte SourcePackageID of type PackageRef when a Source Clip is present; it identifies the referenced package, with 32 zero-valued bytes explicitly terminating the source-reference chain. This is a contextual termination sentinel, not an ordinary generated unique UMID, and does not mean every MXF file contains a Source Clip. The 64-byte Extended UMID is excluded from this Package ID use; the note about other MXF specifications possibly using Extended UMID does not relax that rule. The original official MXF page 8 Scope StrikeOut annotation has unknown authority/meaning. No annotation was removed and no struck-through Scope prose is treated as clean normative evidence. The lower-page ST 330:2011 reference is outside the annotation; pages 18, 118 and 123 have no annotations. Page 8 is not claimed wholly annotation-free. This uses relation is limited to these normative package-identity provisions, preserving existing MXF/KLV objects, descriptions and full-record verification timestamps. It does not establish equivalence, general compatibility, generator uniqueness/authenticity, copyright/rights/trustworthy provenance, complete file or software compliance, cross-implementation interoperability, security certification or IA adoption.

context.conditions_en: Limited to non-core fields 58/59 in the fixed ST 268-1:2014 (formerly ST 268:2014) television header. Section 2 cites exactly ST 12-1:2014; section 6.2 places time code and user bits in four-byte U32 fields at offsets 1920 and 1924, respectively, using Table 6 representation. Table 6 retains SMPTE 12M labels; this does not select a separately reviewed older endpoint or describe complete LTC/VITC waveforms. Section 4.3 allows core readers not to read non-core fields and requires writers to use UNDEFINED when a correct non-core value is unknown; section 4.2 gives FFFFFFFF hex for U32. Undefined is not valid time code, and neither valid time code in every DPX file nor consumption by every core implementation follows. This is a version- and field-conditioned normative uses relation, not signal transport, a mandatory runtime dependency, all-edition compatibility, complete image/software conformance, UTC synchronization, certification or IA adoption. No edges for other DPX references, MXF, ATC, ST 268-2 or implementations are added.

context.conditions_zh: 仅固定 ST 2019-1:2016 基础文本的可选内嵌时间码：§3（第 7 页）明确引用 ST 12-1:2014；§7.2.6 定义偏移 0x030 的 TCP（Time Code Present）标志，1 为有时间码、0 为无。§7.2.7 仅在 TCP=1 时要求 8 字节时间码区遵循 ST 12-1 并按 Table 10 布置（偏移 0x031–0x038）。第 37 页两条资料性注释分别说明码流内时间码已不推荐但仍允许，以及 VC-3 不受 ST 12-1 有限帧率集合约束、TCP=0 时可在带外指定时间码；注释提到 2015 revision 不被当作本次另一个已核实版次。此为有标志、字段及版次边界的 uses，不是建议采用、全码流强制依赖、网络 TCP、完整 LTC/VITC 传输、实现完整符合性、UTC 同步、认证、跨系统互通或 IA 采用。未把 2023 修正、Avid 产品、MXF 或其他不同版次规范引用并入此边。
context.conditions_en: Only the optional in-bitstream time code in the fixed ST 2019-1:2016 base text: section 3 on page 7 cites exactly ST 12-1:2014. Section 7.2.6 defines TCP (Time Code Present) at byte offset 0x030, with 1 meaning present and 0 absent. Section 7.2.7 requires ST 12-1 time code in the eight-byte area only if TCP=1, arranged by Table 10 at offsets 0x031–0x038. The two page-37 informative notes say this in-bitstream feature is deprecated but permitted, VC-3 is not restricted to the limited ST 12-1 frame-rate set, and time code may be out of band when TCP=0. The note mentions a 2015 revision; no separate 2015 edition is inferred or reviewed here. This flag-, field- and edition-conditioned uses relation is not an adoption recommendation, universal bitstream dependency, network TCP, complete LTC/VITC transport, full implementation conformance, UTC synchronization, certification, cross-system interoperability or IA adoption. The 2023 amendment, Avid products, MXF and other dated normative references are not folded into this edge.

context.conditions_zh: 仅核生成的 CreationInfo 五字段：comment 可选单值字符串，created 必需单值时间，createdBy 至少一个 Agent 引用，createdUsing 可选 Tool 引用，specVersion 必需单值 SemVer 形状字符串；类型和属性 IRI 对应 SPDX 3.0.1。赋值/解码会检查类型和模式，但缺少必填值/数量约束由编码阶段检查，构造或加载成功不等于合规。specVersion 语法合法不保证值为 3.0.1。Agent/Tool 可以是未解析字符串，写出这些引用不认证身份、创建事实或工具历史；实际对象仍受自身编码要求约束。created 可指元素最后变更而非导出时间；小数秒字符串被拒绝，datetime 微秒截去，零偏移可归一至 UTC，非零时分偏移字符串被 Z 模式拒绝而非转换，datetime 时区偏移秒会先截去再作 UTC-Z 检查，无时区 datetime 依赖主机时区。未知属性不自动保留，空白节点 ID 和对象顺序可能改变，不承诺任意文档无损往返。JSON-LD 读写及按已识别上下文选择绑定是有限机制，不代表通用 JSON-LD/完整 SPDX 处理；输出摘要不是签名或真实性验证。生成代码证据来自重算哈希的发布归档成员，非虚构 GitHub 源文件；生成器的版本化输入 URL/本地覆盖不证明原始构建输入内容。Python>=3.9、Beta 和 Apache-2.0 为声明；无必需运行时依赖，shacl2code==1.1.0 是构建依赖。未安装、导入、执行或测试库，未网络查询身份，未作生产就绪、完整标准符合性、第三方互通或 IA 采用判断，不改变 IA 来源规则。
context.conditions_en: Only the generated five-field CreationInfo mapping is covered: optional scalar comment, required scalar created, one or more Agent references in createdBy, optional Tool references in createdUsing, and required scalar SemVer-shaped specVersion; type/property IRIs correspond to SPDX 3.0.1. Assignment/decoding checks applicable types/patterns, but missing-value/cardinality checks occur at encoding, so successful construction/loading is not conformance. Valid specVersion syntax does not require value 3.0.1. Agent/Tool references may remain unresolved strings; writing them authenticates neither identities, creation facts nor tooling history, while supplied objects remain subject to their own encoding requirements. Normatively created can mean element last-change time rather than export time. Fractional-second strings are rejected; datetime microseconds truncate; zero offsets can normalize to UTC, strings with nonzero hour/minute offsets fail the Z pattern rather than converting; datetime timezone-offset seconds are truncated before the UTC-Z check, and naive datetime behavior depends on host timezone. Unknown properties are not automatically preserved; blank-node IDs and object ordering can change, so no universal lossless roundtrip is asserted. JSON-LD reading/writing and recognized-context binding selection are limited mechanisms, not generic JSON-LD or complete SPDX processing; output digests are not signatures or authenticity checks. Generated-code evidence is a rehashed released archive member, not an invented GitHub source path; versioned generator-input URLs/local overrides do not prove original build inputs. Python>=3.9, Beta and Apache-2.0 are declarations; no mandatory runtime dependencies, and shacl2code==1.1.0 is build-only. No library installation/import/execution/testing, network identity lookup, production-readiness judgment, full conformance, third-party interoperability or IA adoption is established; IA provenance rules are unchanged.

version_context.reference_boundary: The 2018 SVG document cites a living HTML specification. This paired evidence review does not assert that the 2018 publication cites the later 2026 HTML snapshot, or that every behavior in those documents is identical.

context.conditions_zh: 将既有配合使用评价限定为 HTML 文档结构与内联 SVG 图形的标准层面组合，而非强制采用或全面兼容断言。SVG2 明确支持 SVG 与 HTML 的集成；但 SVG 在独立文件或 XML 中使用 XML 语法，在 HTML 文档中使用 HTML 语法，后者未必兼容 XML。按 XML 解析时须提供使 SVG 元素归属 SVG 命名空间的声明；按 HTML 语法解析时由 HTML parser 自动提供 SVG 命名空间，不要求额外 xmlns。HTML 固定快照将 svg 归入 embedded、phrasing、flow 与 palpable content；foreignObject 内的 HTML 命名空间元素须为 flow content，HTML 文档内 SVG title 的内容模型进一步受 phrasing content 限制。不能由此推定任意 HTML/SVG 混排、同一源码跨 HTML/XML 解析、所有嵌入方式或浏览器功能都可互换。本边不证明实测渲染、脚本/辅助技术互通、完整符合性或 IA 已采用；本文所引 2018 SVG2 文献为 Candidate Recommendation。
context.conditions_en: Scopes the existing paired-use assessment to standards-level composition of HTML document structure with inline SVG graphics, not mandatory adoption or blanket compatibility. SVG2 explicitly supports integration with HTML, but standalone/XML SVG uses XML syntax while SVG within HTML uses HTML syntax, which may not be XML-compatible. XML parsing requires namespace declarations that identify SVG elements; the HTML parser supplies their SVG namespace automatically, without an additional xmlns requirement. The fixed HTML snapshot places svg in embedded, phrasing, flow and palpable content; HTML-namespace elements in foreignObject must be flow content, and SVG title content in HTML documents is further limited to phrasing content. This does not make arbitrary HTML/SVG mixtures, the same source across HTML/XML parsers, embedding modes or browser features interchangeable. Tested rendering, scripting/assistive-technology interoperability, complete conformance and IA adoption are not established. The cited 2018 SVG2 publication is a Candidate Recommendation.

context.conditions_en: Publication-level use: RFC 5424 sections 6 and 6.2.3 derive TIMESTAMP syntax from RFC 3339; section 12.1 identifies the July 2002 RFC as normative. RFC 5424 requires uppercase T/Z and the T separator, prohibits leap seconds, and limits any fractional seconds to one through six digits. NILVALUE is mandatory when system time cannot be obtained and is not an RFC 3339 date-time. These restrictions explain how the original specification uses RFC 3339, not support for every RFC 3339-valid form or a usable timestamp in every message. No whole-protocol dependency, implementation conformance, clock accuracy, actual deployment or IA adoption is asserted. Original publications only; later extensions and errata are not consolidated. The five previously recorded RFC 5424 errata remain unreviewed in contents and status.

version_context.source: TinyCBOR official release/tag v7.1 / da6421f2b5b91e3468c0af7265117427ea73f19e; CMake metadata remains 7.0

context.conditions_zh: 固定整体 TinyCBOR 的官方 release 7.1、轻量 tag v7.1 与 commit da6421f2b5b91e3468c0af7265117427ea73f19e。7.1 是发布/tag 身份；固定 CMakeLists.txt 仍写 project VERSION 7.0，不声称已核二进制或包内版本一致。仅静态追踪 cbor_encoder_init(&encoder, buffer, 9, 0) 后恰一次 cbor_encode_uint(&encoder, value)，映射 RFC 8949 §§3/3.1 的 major type 0 无符号整数，而不是凭源码旧 RFC 7049 注释宣称新版整体符合性。value 为 uint64_t，范围 0..18446744073709551615（含两端）。调用方须提供相互不重叠、生命周期有效且无并发修改的可写 CborEncoder 与真实 9 字节缓冲，buffer+9 合法；uint8_t 是 8 位 unsigned char，uint64_t 为 8 字节，编译器/平台的 cbor_htonll 路径正确产生网络字节序。would_overflow 把指针分别转换成 ptrdiff_t，故另要求该实现转换后的 end 非零，end 与 buffer 的整数差恰为 9，后续减法均有定义且不溢出；仅提供可写空间并不能证明所有 C 平台符合这些前提。CBOR_ENCODER_WRITER_CONTROL 为默认 0，flags 恰为 0，未启用自定义 writer；不审其他构建配置、平台移植性或指针转换。源码先把 remaining 从 2 减为 1，再构造并复制一个 major type 0 项。value 在 0..23、24..255、256..65535、65536..4294967295、4294967296..18446744073709551615 时，依次写 1、2、3、5、9 字节：首段直接内嵌值，其余首字节为 0x18、0x19、0x1a、0x1b，后跟 1、2、4、8 字节大端值。每段选择可用的最短整数头，这是局部源码推导，不是完整确定性编码验证。该有界成功分支返回 CborNoError，将输出指针推进实际长度；cbor_encoder_get_buffer_size 使用原 buffer 返回该长度，extra_bytes_needed 为 0。仅此前缀是编码数据；未写后缀保持原内容，不应发送整个 9 字节缓冲。没有另加 NUL 终止符、容器、tag 或帧封装；编码本身可包含零字节。缺少空间、空指针、无效对象、复用/多次编码、writer 回调、负数、浮点、字符串/UTF-8、容器/重复键、解码、JSON转换和其他 major type 不在正面范围，未审能力不表示不存在。十份选定完整固定仓库文件均核对 Git blob、字节数与 SHA256 后静态阅读；上游测试文件里的 unsigned 边界向量与 encodeOne 只是未执行配方，不是已跑测试或穷尽证明。没有安装、导入、构建、运行上游库、依赖、测试或生成器。没有验证发布归档、完整源树、签名、二进制包、跨实现互通、安全、性能、生产部署或 IA 采用，不声称完整 RFC 8949 符合性。MIT 仅记录固定 LICENSE 声明，不作法律适用判断。
context.conditions_en: Pins the whole TinyCBOR library's official release 7.1, lightweight tag v7.1 and commit da6421f2b5b91e3468c0af7265117427ea73f19e. 7.1 is the release/tag identity: fixed CMakeLists.txt still says project VERSION 7.0, so binary or package version consistency is not verified. Static inspection follows only cbor_encoder_init(&encoder, buffer, 9, 0) and exactly one cbor_encode_uint(&encoder, value), mapped to RFC 8949 sections 3/3.1 major type 0 unsigned integers; older RFC 7049 source comments do not establish full conformance to the newer edition. value is uint64_t in 0..18446744073709551615 inclusive. The caller supplies distinct non-overlapping live writable CborEncoder and genuine nine-byte buffer objects without concurrent modification, with valid buffer+9 arithmetic. uint8_t is eight-bit unsigned char, uint64_t occupies eight bytes, and the selected compiler/platform cbor_htonll path correctly produces network byte order. would_overflow converts pointers separately to ptrdiff_t: the implementation's converted end must be nonzero, its integer difference from buffer exactly nine, and the subsequent subtraction defined without overflow. Writable capacity alone does not establish these premises on every C platform. CBOR_ENCODER_WRITER_CONTROL has its default value zero, flags is exactly zero, and no custom writer is enabled; other build configurations, portability and pointer conversions are not verified. The source decrements remaining from two to one, then constructs and copies one major type 0 item. Values in 0..23, 24..255, 256..65535, 65536..4294967295 and 4294967296..18446744073709551615 write respectively 1, 2, 3, 5 and 9 bytes. The first range embeds the value; other ranges start with 0x18, 0x19, 0x1a or 0x1b followed by 1, 2, 4 or 8 big-endian value bytes. Each range selects the shortest available integer head, a local static deduction rather than complete deterministic-encoding validation. This bounded success branch returns CborNoError and advances the output pointer by the encoded length. cbor_encoder_get_buffer_size with the original buffer returns that length, and extra_bytes_needed is zero. Only that prefix is encoded data; the unwritten suffix retains its prior contents and the entire nine-byte buffer must not be treated as the item. No NUL terminator, container, tag or framing is appended; encoded data itself may contain zero bytes. Insufficient capacity, null pointers, invalid objects, reuse/multiple encodings, writer callbacks, negatives, floats, strings/UTF-8, containers/duplicate keys, decoding, JSON conversion and other major types are outside positive scope; unexamined capabilities are not asserted absent. Ten selected complete pinned repository files were checked against Git blobs, byte counts and SHA256 and read statically. Upstream unsigned boundary vectors and encodeOne are unexecuted recipes, not executed tests or exhaustive proof. No upstream library, dependency, test or generator was installed, imported, built or run. Release archives, the entire source tree, signatures, binary packages, cross-implementation interchange, security, performance, production deployment and IA adoption are unverified; full RFC 8949 conformance is not claimed. MIT records the fixed LICENSE declaration, not legal suitability.

context.conditions_zh: 本记录固定 uriparser 1.0.3、官方 tag uriparser-1.0.3 与 commit fe754ef0d62c882747222c4455cb028b03dca33b，仅静态核验 uriEscapeExA 对 RFC3986 §§2.1/2.3 的组件数据百分号编码，按 §§2.2/2.4 限定调用方责任。仅限 ASCII 兼容平台上的 char API，正面范围是字节 0x01..0x7F，spaceToPlus 与 normalizeBreaks 均须为 URI_FALSE。调用方提供有效可读输入区间 [inFirst,inAfterLast)，有序指针属于同一对象；若 inAfterLast 为 NULL，则输入须是有效 NUL 终止字符串。输出须是与输入不重叠、生命周期有效的可写缓冲，容量至少 3 × n + 1，n 为输入区间字符数（或 NUL 前字符数），容量计算不得溢出。API 没有输出容量参数，也不检查容量；只拒绝输入输出起始指针相等，不能据此声称一般重叠检测。处理在显式区间末尾或首个 NUL 处停止，取先到者；NUL 不会编码为 %00，不是二进制保真编码。ASCII 字母、数字与 -._~ 原样复制，其余范围内字节输出大写 %HH；空格为 %20、CR 为 %0D、LF 为 %0A，斜杠为 %2F、加号为 %2B、百分号为 %25。这些是静态源码推导，不是执行观测。函数追加 NUL，返回指向该终止符的指针，不是整数状态或完整 URI 有效性证明。仅适用于未转义的组件数据，保留字符在该位置必须是数据而非结构分隔符；调用方决定组件与 scheme 语义并负责 URI 组装。已有转义串的百分号会再次编码；不声称整个 URI 保真转换、规范化或资源等价。正面范围外的 spaceToPlus=true 会把空格改为 +；normalizeBreaks=true 会把单独 CR、LF 或 CRLF 改成百分号编码的 CRLF，最坏输出容量需 6 × n + 1，不能泛化为 RFC3986 保证。wchar_t API 不是任意 Unicode 转码；本范围不覆盖高位字节、UTF-8 验证、IRI/IDNA。完整固定源码、头文件及测试配方只读，未安装、构建、导入、运行上游或其测试。test.cpp 的相关配方使用 wchar_t/uriEscapeW，不是 char API 的执行或符合性证据。主体库源码与头文件声明 BSD-3-Clause；仓库另有 LGPL-2.1-or-later 测试和 Apache-2.0 模糊测试例外，不作法律适用性结论。不采用上游严格符合性/性能自述作为验证结果；不验证完整 RFC、URI 解析/ABNF 接收、解析引用、比较/规范化、解码、scheme 有效性、浏览器 URL 行为、网络取回、跨库互通、安全/性能或 IA 采用。未核验能力不等于库不具备。
context.conditions_en: This record pins uriparser 1.0.3, official tag uriparser-1.0.3 and commit fe754ef0d62c882747222c4455cb028b03dca33b, and statically inspects only uriEscapeExA component-data percent encoding under RFC3986 sections 2.1/2.3, with caller responsibilities constrained by sections 2.2/2.4. Positive scope is the char API on an ASCII-compatible platform, bytes 0x01..0x7F, with both spaceToPlus and normalizeBreaks set to URI_FALSE. The caller supplies a valid readable range [inFirst,inAfterLast) with ordered pointers into the same object; if inAfterLast is NULL, input must be a valid NUL-terminated string. Output must be a disjoint writable buffer with valid lifetime and capacity at least 3 × n + 1, where n is the input-range length or characters before NUL, using overflow-safe capacity arithmetic. The API has no output-capacity argument and performs no capacity check. It rejects equal starting input/output pointers only, not general overlap. Processing stops at the explicit end or first NUL, whichever comes first; NUL is not encoded as %00, so this is not binary-preserving encoding. ASCII letters, digits and -._~ are copied; every other included byte becomes uppercase %HH. Space becomes %20, CR %0D, LF %0A, slash %2F, plus %2B and percent %25. These examples are static source inferences, not execution observations. The function appends NUL and returns a pointer to that terminator, not an integer status or proof of complete-URI validity. Scope is unescaped component data whose reserved characters are data rather than structural delimiters; callers determine component/scheme semantics and assemble the URI. Already escaped percent signs are encoded again; no URI-preserving whole-string transformation, normalization or resource equivalence is claimed. Outside positive scope, spaceToPlus=true changes spaces to +, while normalizeBreaks=true changes lone CR/LF and CRLF into percent-encoded CRLF, needing worst-case 6 × n + 1 output capacity; these options are not generic RFC3986 guarantees. The wchar_t API is not arbitrary Unicode transcoding; high-bit bytes, UTF-8 validation and IRI/IDNA are excluded. Complete pinned source, headers and test recipes were read only, without upstream installation, build, import, execution or tests. Related test.cpp recipes use wchar_t/uriEscapeW and are not char-API execution or conformance evidence. Library source/headers declare BSD-3-Clause; the repository separately excepts LGPL-2.1-or-later tests and Apache-2.0 fuzzing, without a legal-suitability conclusion. Upstream strict-conformance/performance claims are not adopted as verification. Full RFC conformance, URI parsing/ABNF acceptance, reference resolution, comparison/normalization, decoding, scheme validity, browser URL behavior, network retrieval, cross-library interoperability, security/performance and IA adoption are unverified. Unexamined capabilities are not asserted absent.

Particular role and aria-* uses remain subject to HTML host-language authoring constraints, not a blanket permission for every combination or for ARIA to override all native semantics. This concerns accessibility semantics expressed through roles, states and properties, not proof that custom-widget interaction is implemented. The non-normative ARIA in HTML section 2 example states that aria-disabled=true on a hyperlink does not make it functionally unclickable or inoperable. User-agent ARIA processing must not interfere with built-in host features or alter the DOM to remap ARIA into host features; accessibility API mappings may change. This does not establish complete WCAG conformance, interoperability of a particular browser/assistive-technology combination, or IA-page adoption/conformance.

Authors must manage focus for the listed composite-container roles. With aria-activedescendant, assistive technology receives active-descendant focus information while DOM focus can remain on the container or controlling input. aria-keyshortcuts exposes shortcuts without automatically changing user-agent keyboard behavior; authors must handle scripted keyboard events. This does not establish usability evaluation or page conformance.

context.conditions_zh: 限定为 YAML 表示图、序列化树与字符流之间的数据表示和转换。映射键顺序与锚点名称是序列化细节，注释和样式是呈现细节，不构成原生数据构造所依据的信息；这不表示样式对标签解析毫无影响：plain scalar 在标签解析中需与带引号的标量区分，构造阶段则依据表示图。此边不承诺往返保留这些细节。完整加载还依赖标签解析、标签内容有效性和可用原生类型，不能据格式能力推断任意处理器或跨应用往返成功。本次未验证 IA 实际 YAML 处理、实现符合性或应用互通。
context.conditions_en: Limited to data representation and conversion among YAML representation graphs, serialization trees and character streams. Mapping key order and anchor names are serialization details; comments and styles are presentation details, not information used to construct native data. This does not mean styles never affect tag resolution: plain scalars are distinguished from quoted scalars for that purpose; construction uses the representation graph. This edge does not promise their round-trip preservation. Complete loading also depends on tag resolution, tag/content validity and available native types; the format capability does not prove arbitrary processor or cross-application round trips. IA YAML processing, implementation conformance and application interoperability were not tested.
